title: All In
direct_author_raw:
play episode 50. 

brians sleeping activities needs to come about to episodes. 
it comes at stages
1. while sitting and sleeping, he opens and closes his knees over n over like a sorry ass squidward, brian thrusting his hips in the air while making noises like as if hes maxing out on reps. 
2. sleep walking, he’ll pick up random shit, make food, one time he spilt coffee on himself and said it was hot.. it wasn’t
3. questionable behavior, this is a real ass story that i want to be a reoccurring gag but dont overplay it, brian stands in front of chris while sleep walking, takes he shirt off then spins it around like a lasso or a tweaker magic mike, throws it in the distance, turns his back at chris, BAM, brians white haired hairy asscheeks brighter than the fucken moon, brighter than goddamn gates to heaven. chris says “BRIAN WHAT THE FUCK” as he kicks his leg. brian wakes up instantly pulls up his shorts and plays it off as if nothing happen. 
———-
imagine dr evil or tpp seeing this shit for the first time. classic..
————-
what happened to manas brainstormed episodes? kaze introduced gambling to chris, then chris did the same with mana. dana walks in the bar wanting a beer, hes stressed out from mana running away and galavanting. boom, he sees chris mana kaze at the poker table surrounded by other NPCs, all three of them going all in on bets no matter what kinda cards they have. read the sources so you dont forget anything. 
———-
that little man humor with brian is absolutely hilarious, his little hands, little feet, climbing on a chair then climbing down, his eye level facing the fucken table. TRIPLE DOWN ON THIS HUMOR. dont be repetitive, be original like you have been.
